hook.text: On this rock and fusion record, 坂本龍一 plays keyboards on RADIO RIO, just after joining YMO.

sentences.text: It is the fifth original album by the guitarist 高中正義, and it came out about a year and five months after BRASILIAN SKIES.
In May 1980 BLUE LAGOON, the first track on side A, was cut as a single and used as the song for a Pioneer commercial.

listen_for.text: It is a cover of a song included on the 1972 album Ben by the Brazilian guitarist ジョルジュ・ベン.
